name: lit-critic
description: Multi-lens editorial review system for fiction manuscripts

scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ts
scripts.release:check: npm run check:release-intent && npm run validate:semver
scripts.install: npm run install:python && npm run install:ts
scripts.install:python: if not exist .venv (python -m venv .venv) && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv\Scripts\pip install -e ".[test]"

author: Alexis Argyris
